title: Dense screen
scenario: Variants default and uhd-192dpi: 2,000 controls (a 40 x 50 grid of cells cycling three Labels, Button, Checkbox, Toggle, ProgressBar, Slider) filling 1920x1080 DIP, at 1920x1080 and 96 DPI or at 3840x2160 and 192 DPI. typography-120: the same screen with a two-row Tree in place of every eighth cell's Label and every Label and Tree typed by one of 120 distinct (size, weight) typographies. form-10k: 10,000 controls in one ScrollPanel, 2,000 rows of Label, TextField, Checkbox, Toggle and Button. Absolute layout, reduced motion. Phases: full frames, one hover change, one Label text change, wheel scrolling. Per-control memory is the built sample's tracked live bytes over the control count. G5 is a hardware timing verdict: not measured here.
cppAllocations: not counted: this executable does not replace the allocation functions
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: an unchanged frame, then the pointer moves onto the first and the second hover button

phases.name: full
phases.description: ControlHost::Invalidate with nothing changed: a full frame

phases.name: hover
phases.description: the pointer moves between two adjacent buttons: one hover change per frame

phases.name: value
phases.description: one Label's text changes, its bounds unchanged

phases.name: scroll
phases.description: one wheel notch down over the form (form-10k); the dense screen has nothing to scroll, so its frames are unchanged

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: not measured: this executable does not replace the allocation functions

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX12 -Variant form-10k -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost window -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
